releases.name: v1.1.2 Persistent browser session profiles
releases.body:
## 1.1.2 (2026-05-19)

### Features
- Added opt-in persistent per-origin Chromium profiles via `session.enabled`, allowing sites to reuse cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB, and anti-bot challenge credentials across `webfetch` calls.
- Added `session.cacheDir` config option. When unset, profiles are stored under the global OpenCode config directory in `cloakfetch-sessions`.
- Skips automatic per-origin profiles when `cloakbrowser.launchOptions.userDataDir` is explicitly configured.
- Added profile locking with heartbeat and stale-lock cleanup so concurrent fetches do not corrupt the same persistent profile.

### Maintenance
- Updated `packageManager`, CI, and release workflows to `pnpm@11.1.3`.
- Added tests for session defaults, origin-stable profile paths, privacy-safe profile names, manual `userDataDir` precedence, config merging, profile creation, and lock release.
- Added repository agent instructions for future maintenance.

### Documentation
- Documented the new `session` configuration block in README and `configSchema.json`.
- Clarified that persistent sessions are opt-in because they store site session data on disk.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/partment/opencode-cloak-fetch/compare/v1.1.1...v1.1.2

releases.name: v1.1.1 Challenge-aware fetch waiting
releases.body:
## 1.1.1 (2026-05-16)

### Features

- Added challenge-aware fetch waiting for detected anti-bot challenge pages before content extraction.
- Added `timeout.challengeWaitMs` config option, defaulting to `20000`; set it to `0` to disable challenge waiting.
- Supports technical challenge fingerprints for Cloudflare, DDoS-Guard, DataDome, Akamai Bot Manager, Imperva/Incapsula, and PerimeterX.

### Fixes
- Fixed OpenCode tool argument schema generation to avoid Zod instance mismatches between this package and `@opencode-ai/plugin`.

### Maintenance
- Pinned runtime and development dependency versions.
- Updated `@opencode-ai/plugin` to `1.15.0` and `zod` to `4.4.3`.
- Added challenge detection and config coverage tests.

### Documentation
- Documented `timeout.challengeWaitMs`.
- Added npm version badge and standardized README type formatting.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/partment/opencode-cloak-fetch/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1
